references.text: Detailed instructions about the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים), which forms the basis of the Nazirite offerings described in Numbers 6:17.
Further regulations concerning the peace offering, including how it is to be eaten and handled.
Reference to unleavened bread (מַצּוֹת) in a basket, also mentioned in the Nazirite's concluding sacrifice.
Regulations about the grain offering (מִנְחָה) that the priest was to perform along with the other sacrifices.
Instructions regarding the drink offering (נֶסֶךְ) that was to accompany other offerings.
The preceding verses describing the other sacrifices the Nazirite was to bring, including the burnt offering and sin offering.
An example of a peace offering being brought together with a grain offering in connection with the dedication of the tabernacle.
